description: Add rows to the end of an existing dataset, sending only the new rows — the rows already in the table stay as they are, so there is no need to read them first. Every row must have as many columns as the table already has; a row that doesn't is rejected and nothing at all is written. Appending to an empty dataset takes the column count from the first row.

rows.description: The rows to add to the end of the table (data rows only — no header row). Each row must have the same number of columns as the dataset.

name: append_dataset_rows
title: Append Dataset Rows
